      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object

        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. Stored and returned in E.164 form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

          format: date

      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. Stored and returned in E.164 form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where
                LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and
                NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more
                than the number of owners at the time the owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented the household-duplicate rejection rule on `POST /api/owners`.

**Changes:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added a `sharesHousehold` boolean property (write-only, optional) to the `OwnerFields` schema, so the generated `OwnerFieldsDto` exposes `getSharesHousehold()`.

2. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — In `addOwner`, after the existing telephone-conflict check, added:
   ```java
   if (!Boolean.TRUE.equals(ownerFieldsDto.getSharesHousehold()) && isHouseholdDuplicate(owner)) {
       return new ResponseEntity<>(HttpStatus.CONFLICT);
   }
   ```
   Plus two helpers: `isHouseholdDuplicate(owner)` scans existing owners for a match on both `lastName` and `address`, and `normalize(value)` trims, collapses internal whitespace runs to a single space, and lower-cases — so the comparison is case-insensitive with collapsed whitespace, per the spec.

**Behavior:**
- Same `lastName` + same `address` (case/whitespace-insensitive) → **409 Conflict**.
- Same `lastName` but different `address` → allowed.
- Duplicate but `sharesHousehold: true` → allowed.

The full test suite (including the three new acceptance tests: `coreRejectsSameLastNameAndAddress`, `functionalityAllowsDifferentAddress`, `functionalityAllowsWithSharesHousehold`) is green.
